# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Before reporting

Read [documentation index](../docs/README.md), [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md), [configuration](../docs/configuration.md) and [limitations](../docs/limitations.md). Confirm the exact Git commit and whether the issue reproduces without a live provider.

## Where to ask

- Reproducible software defects: choose the **Bug report** issue template.
- Documentation corrections and feature suggestions: choose **Feature request**.
- Usage and integration questions: choose **Question**.
- Security vulnerabilities or leaked tokens: **do not use public issues**; follow [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

Include sanitized logs, environment details and expected/actual behavior. Remove keys, endpoint tokens, sensitive translation content and personal data.

## Support boundaries

This is an open-source project without a guaranteed response schedule or hosted service SLA. External providers manage their own availability and billing.
